title: Leome and Partners team
description: A full-bleed photo panel, window-high on phones and 3:2 on wide screens, with two corner marks, a big two-line heading at the bottom-left that rises line by line as it scrolls in, and an underlined rolling link at the bottom-right. The photo drifts against the scroll.
notes: made for light text over a dark photo: on light themes the scrim fades to the light card colour instead
all motion is CSS scroll-driven; off under prefers-reduced-motion
name: leome-and-partners-team
